descriptions.w3d_d28e_add_draw_block_801aa15c: Append a draw block to list index: skips kind 3 lists. When the current material differs from the entry at the mark it stores the source matrix into the material and pushes it; a changed transform takes a 512-per-chunk pool element, copies the matrix and pushes it. Then it takes a 16-byte block from the arena at +232, sets its depth from kind (zero, or the matrix's z), packs the transform index, current and mark into the word at +12, stores key and link, and pushes the block on the list.
